origin.description: Sample k values from 1:n, or from a numeric vector.
origin.details: Length 4 and 1 when the values are a subset of 1:10.
origin.value: Sample k values from 1:n, or from a numeric vector.
origin.example: { x <- randsample(10, 4); c(length(x), as.numeric(all(x >= 1 & x <= 10) && length(unique(x)) == 4)) }
